findings.title: hierarchy members/move reference unbound ControlPanelDb type

findings.title: root router index.ts inferred type exceeds serialization limit

findings.title: google-calendar handler call missing organizationId
~38 unused-import (TS6133) + members DispatchStaffSyncFn (TS6196) lint-level compile errors
findings.note: noUnusedLocals turns these into build failures; mostly leftover imports from the Plan D-S7 router splits.

findings.title: Refunded commission still paid out — reversal rows written but split status never flipped; settler is orphan
findings.note: approveRefund->reverseForRefund writes commission_split_reversals but processCommissionReversals (the only settler) has no production caller (only tests). runBatch still pays refunded commission = money leak.

findings.title: Expense approval/payment is status-flag only — no audit row, no ledger/payout side-effect
findings.note: Unlike sibling services it never calls writeAudit; approved expenses never hit a ledger or payout.

findings.title: Refund processing never restocks product inventory
findings.note: Refunding a product sale returns money but on-hand stock is not incremented.

findings.title: payout_batches table + helpers never wired into live payout flow
findings.note: getOrCreatePayoutBatch/attachPayoutsToBatch orphaned; markPaidById silently discards required paymentReference.

findings.title: tax-rates deactivate silently clears default flag instead of blocking
Non-Stripe POS sales stuck at 'confirmed' — never reach 'completed'
findings.note: Cash/card/transfer/fpx inserted as confirmed; only the Stripe webhook sets completed. getLatest 'Last Receipt' is null forever for non-Stripe tenants; completed-revenue KPIs under-report.

findings.title: POS product sales perform no stock decrement / no stock_movements ledger
findings.note: Confirmed cross-domain with inventory agent: only goods-receipts.create moves stock; sales never decrement product_stock; no stock_movements table anywhere.

findings.title: POS trusts client-supplied unitPriceCents (never re-resolves via pricing.service)
findings.note: Price tampering risk; should re-resolve server-side.

findings.title: searchPosCustomers only queries members — walk-in search unimplemented
KPI outstandingCents hardcoded 0; two divergent race-prone order-number generators
(CORRECTED) Claimed undefined itemNet at pos.service.ts:622/652 — FALSE
findings.note: itemNet IS declared at line 602 (itemGross - itemDiscount). services package type-checks clean of this. POS agent's headline P1 was a false finding; dropped.

findings.title: Class-slot cancellation never cancels/refunds enrolled clients or clears waitlist
Waitlist promote consumes a slot spot but creates no booking; no auto-promotion on cancel
Google Calendar disconnect/list send ENCRYPTED token (never decrypted) — revoke fails, list 401s
Drop-in/bulk check-in does not deduct package credit
No reminder/no-show/recurrence-materialization automation; enrollment skips buffer/double-book checks
Membership freeze writes status='paused' — not in package-instances enum; two unreconciled freeze systems
findings.note: Lifecycle path uses 'frozen'; memberships 'frozen' filter keys off is_locked which no freeze path sets.

findings.title: auto-resume-holds cron handler exists but not wired into worker scheduled dispatcher
findings.note: Frozen memberships never auto-resume; no expiry sweep for non-installment packages.

findings.title: cancelMembershipHold never un-pauses the package (stranded in paused)
reject/bulkReject cancel paid pending packages with no refund
findings.note: Acknowledged v1-scope per agent.

findings.title: Walk-in CRUD deprecated — list returns hardcoded empty, mutations throw 'deprecated'
findings.note: CORRECTED framing: the /customers/walk-in/view route is intentionally LEGACY and redirects to /dashboard/customers/v2/view. Verify whether v2 fully replaces walk-in before treating as a defect.

findings.title: Household mutations leak across hierarchy — addMember/create skip accessibleNodeIds scope check
findings.note: Branch-A staffer can link a branch-B customer; sibling reads enforce scope.

findings.title: creditPoints and households are write-only lifecycle dead-ends
findings.note: Credit balance fills but nothing debits; household tag never propagates billing to parent-payer.

findings.title: walk-in->package conversion fully implemented but has zero frontend callers
Legacy purchaseOrders.receiveItems marks PO received without moving stock; competes with goods-receipts path

validatePromoCode ignores product/service applicability + branch scope; free_item/buy_x_get_y treated as flat discount

stock-request/transfer transitions lack current-status guards — fulfill/complete double-move hazard

findings.title: members.retryGhlSync has NO permission gate

findings.title: markExpiredInvitations orphan — not wired into CF scheduled handler

Notification preferences are write-only — no delivery code reads the 7 channel toggles
